setups.estM1440: smoke 189 -> ~13 at default; runBars 2 corner ~20, runBars 4 corner ~8
setups.rationale: Whole bars above a slow EMA still in bearish order = price breaking out of a downtrend before the MAs turn. runBars is the note's 2-4; slowLength 50/75/100 varies how stale the bearish order is. FastEmaAboveSlowEma (authored) is the exact negation of the setup's MA-order test.

setups.estM1440: DoubleEmaTouchRun alone (same-sided) smoke 1130 -> ~78; with the flipped MA-order placement roughly half the touch runs, ~30-40 at runBars 3, ~15 at runBars 5
setups.rationale: Note #39 / CATALOG row: DoubleEmaTouchRun gives no direction, so the setup is [DoubleEmaTouchRun, FastEmaAboveSlowEma flipped] = long when bars straddle both EMAs while EMA25 < EMA50 (reversal). EMA lengths are pinned 25/50 in BOTH placements so they describe the same averages (a template cannot tie two optimized inputs); only runBars (note's 3-5) is optimized. FastEmaAboveSlowEma in pane 2 duplicates the cluster's own placement. MaStackGapNarrowing must go in AUTHORED (its long side is fast<slow, consistent); flipped it would contradict. MaWickTouchesHoldSide (EMA50) will pass rarely here because straddling run bars reset its count.

setups.estM1440: smoke 69 -> ~5 at default (= the tight corner 1.0/0.25); loose corner 0.5/0.75 perhaps ~20-30
setups.rationale: Price has lived well above the EMA and come back to it: a pullback in an established trend. Defaults are rare, so the grid leans loose from the default corner (minLongAtr down to 0.5, maxShortAtr up to 0.75). Lengths pinned at the note's reading.

setups.estM1440: smoke 129 -> ~9 at default (200/3, the tight corner); loose corner 100/1.5 perhaps ~25
setups.rationale: Trades THROUGH the long EMA after an unusually long absence, expecting it not to hold: a breakout. Default is rare-ish, so gapMultiple leans loose (1.5-3) and the EMA shortens to 100 for more touches. maxScanBars pinned 500 -> Max Bars Back 500 (the brief's known case).

setups.estM1440: smoke 1157 -> ~80 at default (a state; count ~ side changes); 2.0 corner well under half that
setups.rationale: Close beyond a body-average band = breakout. Both knobs centred on the defaults 20/1.5 (bandLength 10/30/50). Frequent, so no need to loosen.

Price flips to and holds the other side of the EMA after a longer spell = a breakout through the average. priorBars >= 5 > recentBars <= 4 keeps the note's Y > X everywhere. With FastEmaAboveSlowEma (authored) the joint rate is low, since EMA25 usually still lags below EMA50 at the flip, but it is not contradictory.

setups.estM1440: smoke 189 -> ~13 at default (5/0.6); loose corner 3/0.5 ~25, tight 7/0.7 ~5
setups.rationale: Fade at a level whose past visits were wick rejections (short at rejected-from-above, long at rejected-from-below): range edge fade. Authored long is support holding, not flipped. LevelBodyDominated is the strict complement of the wick classes (body >= 0.6 leaves wicks <= 0.4) so it never co-fires at the 0.5-0.7 grid.

setups.estM1440: smoke 886 -> ~60 at default (10/0.5); tight 15/1.5 corner perhaps ~10
setups.rationale: Long where past visits were followed by up moves: the level's historical reaction, read as support/resistance (range). horizon stop 15 < minGap 20 so every visit stays forward-complete. Frequent at default, so driftAtr leans tighter (0.5-1.5).

Price in thin air, entered with momentum: a breakout into untraded territory. The four Level* regime conditions need >= 5 visits while this setup needs <= 4, so they never co-fire (negated, they pass trivially and duplicate it).

conditions.passRate: ~45-60% of bars per side (an MA-order state; near 50/50 overall, skewed by trend)
conditions.rationale: Classic MA order. Pinned at the note's 25/50 (inside the grid, slow at the grid's low end) so the pane-2 placement matches the DoubleEmaTouchRun cluster's averages; familyGrid centre is 25/75.

conditions.passRate: ~10-20% of bars per side (falling stack AND narrowing gap); below the 20% aim but not degenerate
conditions.rationale: Confirmed from the code: long = fast < slow, both falling over narrowLookback, gap narrowing - a downtrend losing steam, so reversal-context. Place it AUTHORED under reversal setups.

conditions.passRate: ~25-35% long, ~20-30% short at 50/2 (state persists between touches); touchCount 3 roughly halves it
conditions.rationale: The EMA holding as support (long) / resistance (short): a trend confirmation. Pinned touchCount 2 rather than the default 3 to keep the pass rate in range.

conditions.passRate: ~25-40% (body share of range is ~0.5 on average, so >= 0.6 is the upper part; fails in thin air)
conditions.rationale: Same-sided level character; family pane 2 = it | it negated. lookback 500 -> Max Bars Back 500 (known Level* case).

conditions.passRate: ~35-50% at 25 once warm; biased toward FAIL for the first ~500 evaluated bars because visit-bar ADX before the first evaluated bar reads 0 (zero-fill), which on M1440 is ~15% of the 3,270 bars
conditions.rationale: Mean ADX at the visit bars; threshold spans the 20/25/30 regime boundary. ADX length pinned at 14.

conditions.passRate: ~35-50% at 1.0 (a bar's range averages ~0.85-0.9 x ATR, but wide bars are likelier to contain the close); the default 1.2 is probably ~15-25%
conditions.rationale: Centred below the default 1.2 because range < true range makes 1.2 selective; 0.8-1.2 spans small vs big.

conditions.passRate: ~35-50% at 1.0; secular volume growth makes older visits read low, so the default 1.2 likely passes well under 25%
conditions.rationale: Centred at 1.0 for the same reason as LevelBigBars; volumeLookback pinned at 50.
